name: output_validator
title_zh: 交付物过 QA 门禁前，先让它自检语法与合规
tagline_zh: 每次交付前自动跑语法校验、合规扫描、质量打分，把低级错误拦在评审前。省得你被 QA 打回重做，还附具体扣分点。
tagline_en: Auto-run syntax, compliance, and quality checks before you submit, catching low-level errors early. Avoid QA.
desc_en: Performs rigorous syntax verification, compliance inspection, and quality scoring on deliverables for the QA Auditor review gate.
why_zh: 它把 QA 的检查逻辑前置到交付前，用同一套标准打分，让你提前知道哪里会扣分，而不是等评审时被当众挑刺。
why_en: Front-loads QA's review logic into your workflow, scoring against the same rubric so you know where points will be lost before.
limit_zh: 只针对文本类交付物（如文档、代码注释、配置片段），不检查二进制或运行行为；需要你预先定义好合规规则。
limit_en: Only for text deliverables (docs, code comments, config snippets); no binary or runtime checks. Needs your predefined compliance rules; otherwise.
title_en: Pre-QA gate self-check for syntax, compliance, and quality.
